IVX — SOURCE OF TRUTH / PRODUCTION SECURITY RECONCILIATION
MODE: SENIOR DEVELOPER EXECUTION
NO NARRATIVE-ONLY COMPLETION
NO FALSE DEPLOYMENT
NO FALSE CERTIFICATION

IMPORTANT:
A separate GitHub code audit has verified that the current authorized IVX feature
branch contains a secured wire implementation.

Repository source of truth:
@[github:https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fibb142%2Fivx-holdings-platform:GitHub Sync - ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform]

Authorized working branch:
fix/senior-certification-hard-gates

DO NOT assume the local Rork workspace is canonical.
DO NOT deploy a divergent repository.
DO NOT claim a production vulnerability still exists until comparing the exact
deployed production SHA/source against the GitHub source of truth.

==================================================
1. PROVE REPOSITORY IDENTITY FIRST — HARD GATE
==================================================

Before making any more changes, output and preserve evidence for:

git remote -v
git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git log -1 --oneline
git status --short

Resolve:

CANONICAL_REPO = ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
CANONICAL_BRANCH = fix/senior-certification-hard-gates
CANONICAL_HEAD = read directly from GitHub

Read GitHub branch HEAD through authenticated GitHub tooling.

Compare:

LOCAL_HEAD
GITHUB_FEATURE_HEAD
GITHUB_MAIN_HEAD
RENDER_PRODUCTION_SHA

If histories differ:
DO NOT deploy.
DO NOT cherry-pick blindly.
DO NOT force push.

Produce a four-way SHA matrix.

==================================================
2. VERIFY THE WIRE FINDING AGAINST CURRENT GITHUB CODE
==================================================

Read CURRENT GitHub file:

backend/api/ivx-wire-transfer.ts

The current expected bank-grade contract is:

- handleSecureWireInstructions requires verified Supabase JWT
- handleSecureWireSubmission requires verified Supabase JWT
- userId/email/name are derived server-side from auth user
- body-supplied userId must not determine stored identity
- referenceCode must belong to authenticated member
- invalid/fake bearer returns 401
- bank instructions require authentication
- routing/account details are not public

DO NOT overwrite this secure implementation with older Rork workspace code.

Then inspect CURRENT:

server.ts

Verify the productionFetch edge guard routes:

/api/ivx/wire-instructions
/api/ivx/wire-submission

to the secure handlers BEFORE legacy Hono routes can process them.

Required negative test:

POST /api/ivx/wire-submission
without Authorization

Expected:
401

Required attack test:

POST /api/ivx/wire-submission
with body:
{
  "userId": "VICTIM_USER_ID",
  ...
}

authenticated as USER_A.

Expected:
stored identity = USER_A
never VICTIM_USER_ID.

If production still accepts unauthenticated submission:
the deployed source is stale.
Report:
SOURCE_FIXED=true
PRODUCTION_STALE=true
Do NOT describe the feature branch as vulnerable.

==================================================
3. PROVE WHICH REPOSITORY RENDER BUILDS
==================================================

Use the authenticated Render API.

Read the target service configuration.

Record WITHOUT PRINTING SECRETS:

service id
service name
repository URL
branch
autoDeploy setting
last deploy id
last deploy commit
deploy status

Required relationship:

Render repository =
@[github:https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fibb142%2Fivx-holdings-platform:GitHub Sync - ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform]

If Render is connected to another repository or stale clone:
STOP.

Do not trigger deployment until source-of-truth alignment is fixed.

==================================================
4. RECONCILE THE TWO HISTORIES SAFELY
==================================================

Do NOT replace GitHub history with the Rork workspace.

The GitHub repo is authoritative unless the owner explicitly says otherwise.

For every local Rork-only security fix:

- identify exact file
- generate actual diff against GitHub feature branch
- determine whether GitHub already contains equivalent/newer protection
- copy only genuinely missing code
- do not downgrade newer GitHub security code

Especially protect:

backend/api/ivx-wire-transfer.ts
backend/api/ivx-secure-wallet.ts
backend/api/ivx-direct-auth.ts
server.ts
backend/ivx-bank-privacy.test.ts
backend/supabase/migrations/*
expo/ivxholding-landing/*
expo/app/wire-transfer.tsx

==================================================
5. APK / ANDROID SECRET AUDIT — HARD GATE
==================================================

Do not merely inspect .env files.

Build the release artifact using the intended production build process.

Then inspect the generated:

APK/AAB
classes.dex
resources
JS bundle
AndroidManifest
BuildConfig
Expo constants/config

Search for actual credential CLASSES, without printing their values:

GitHub PAT patterns
Render API tokens
Supabase service_role JWT
Supabase access tokens
AI provider secret keys
AWS secret access keys
Twilio auth tokens
private keys
database passwords

Allowed client-side values:

Supabase publishable/anon client key
public API host
public project identifiers
non-secret analytics/public IDs

Forbidden in mobile binary:

service_role
GitHub write token
Render API token
database password
AI provider secret
Twilio auth token
AWS secret access key
owner system secret

If any forbidden credential is present:
REMOVE its client-side binding.
Move the operation behind authenticated backend API.

Then rebuild APK/AAB and scan again.

PASS only when forbidden_secret_matches = 0.

Do NOT output secret values.

==================================================
6. ENVIRONMENT FILE GOVERNANCE
==================================================

A local .env existing twice is not itself a security certificate failure.

Determine:

- which env file is actually consumed by Expo
- which is consumed by backend
- which is consumed by Android build
- whether either is tracked by Git
- whether secrets are copied into client bundle

There must be ONE documented canonical source per runtime.

Backend secrets:
server/runtime only.

Mobile:
public client configuration only.

Never copy backend secrets into EXPO_PUBLIC_*.

Never put:
GITHUB_TOKEN
RENDER_API_KEY
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
SUPABASE_DB_URL
AI provider secret keys
IVX system secrets
into Expo public variables.

==================================================
7. CREDENTIAL VALIDITY — DO NOT MIX WITH SOURCE SECURITY
==================================================

For each integration report independently:

GitHub
Render
Supabase
AI provider
Twilio
AWS

Possible statuses only:

BOUND_AND_VALID
PRESENT_BUT_UNAUTHORIZED
EXPIRED_OR_REVOKED
MISSING_BINDING
UNVERIFIED

HTTP 401/403 must include:
provider
endpoint category
HTTP status
sanitized error

Do NOT call 401 from GitHub proof that application code is broken.

Do NOT ask the owner for a credential unless runtime verification proves
the existing stored credential is missing, expired, revoked or unauthorized.

==================================================
8. BANK-GRADE SECURITY REGRESSION
==================================================

Run:

backend bank privacy tests
wire authentication tests
wallet authorization tests
cross-user tests
secret scan
TypeScript
lint
Expo tests

Mandatory attacks:

anonymous wire submission -> denied
fake bearer -> denied
User A claims User B userId -> ignored/denied
User A wire reference used by User B -> denied
anonymous full wire instructions -> denied
direct wallet self-credit -> denied
cross-user financial read -> denied
cross-user financial write -> denied

All must be actual test executions.

==================================================
9. PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT RULE
==================================================

Do NOT deploy until:

GitHub feature branch contains final fix
CI on exact SHA is green
Render source repository is verified
Render branch/deployment source is verified

If branch deployment is supported and authorized:
deploy exact approved feature SHA.

Otherwise:
report that merge approval is required.

NEVER silently merge main.

After actual deployment verify:

GET /version
GET /health

Required:

production_commit == deployed_commit

Then run live wire negative tests again.

==================================================
10. CERTIFICATE
==================================================

ONLY issue:

IVX SOURCE-OF-TRUTH + PRODUCTION SECURITY CERTIFICATE — PASS

when all are proven:

canonical GitHub repo identified
no repository divergence affecting deploy
exact final Git SHA recorded
CI green on exact SHA
release APK/AAB forbidden-secret scan = 0
anonymous wire submission denied
body userId impersonation denied
fake bearer denied
wallet self-credit denied
Render source repo verified
deployment exact SHA verified
health PASS
version SHA match
post-deploy negative security tests PASS

If production cannot be updated because GitHub authentication is 401:

RESULT:
CODE FIX = PASS or FAIL based on code/tests
DEPLOYMENT = BLOCKED_AUTH
PRODUCTION = NOT CERTIFIED

Do not call the code vulnerable merely because deployment is blocked.

==================================================
11. EVIDENCE OUTPUT
==================================================

Return only:

1. canonical repo + branch
2. four-way SHA matrix
3. actual files changed
4. test names + counts
5. APK/AAB secret scan counts
6. provider credential binding statuses
7. Render service/source evidence
8. deployment evidence
9. unresolved blockers
10. certificate verdict

NO SECRET VALUES.
NO STORY-TELLING.
NO FAKE PASS.
NO DEPLOYMENT CLAIM WITHOUT EXACT-SHA PROOF.

EXECUTE NOW.
